## Setup
```{r}

library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)

data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
df <- tibble(PimaIndiansDiabetes)

# Set target variable
df <- df %>%
  rename(target = diabetes)

# Split data (85% training, 15% testing)
set.seed(123)

splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$target, p = .85,
                                  list = FALSE)

df_train <- df[splitIndex, ]
df_test <- df[-splitIndex, ]

# 7-fold cross-validation
trControl <- trainControl(method = "cv",
                          number = 7)

```

## Q1
```{r}
# Check parameters
getModelInfo("ranger")$ranger$parameters

# Set tuning parameters
tuneGrid <- expand.grid(
  mtry = 2:4,
  splitrule = c("gini", "extratrees"),
  min.node.size = 1:10
)

# Train random forest
set.seed(123)

forest_ranger <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
                       method = "ranger",
                       trControl = trControl,
                       tuneGrid = tuneGrid)

# Plot tuning results
plot(forest_ranger)

# Show results
print(forest_ranger)

# Best parameters
forest_ranger$bestTune

# Test accuracy
pred <- predict(forest_ranger, df_test)

cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred,
                      reference = df_test$target,
                      positive = "pos")

cm$overall[1]
```

## Q2
```{r}
# Set tuning parameters
tuneGrid2 <- expand.grid(maxdepth = 2:10)

# Train Decision Tree
set.seed(123)

tree <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
              method = "rpart2",
              trControl = trControl,
              tuneGrid = tuneGrid2)

# Plot tuning results
plot(tree)

# Show results
print(tree)

# Best parameter
tree$bestTune

# Test accuracy
pred2 <- predict(tree, df_test)

cm2 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred2,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm2$overall[1]
```

## Q3
```{r}
# Train Decision Tree
set.seed(123)

tree3 <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
               method = "rpart2",
               trControl = trControl)

# Train Linear Discriminant Analysis
set.seed(123)

lda <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
             method = "lda",
             trControl = trControl)

# Compare models
results <- resamples(list("Decision Tree" = tree3,
                          "LDA" = lda))

# Plot comparison
bwplot(results)

# Show comparison
summary(results)

# Select the model with higher CV accuracy
accuracy_tree <- max(tree3$results$Accuracy)
accuracy_lda <- max(lda$results$Accuracy)

if (accuracy_tree >= accuracy_lda) {
  final_model <- tree3
  print("Decision Tree is the best model")
} else {
  final_model <- lda
  print("LDA is the best model")
}

# Test final model
pred3 <- predict(final_model, df_test)

cm3 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred3,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm3$overall[1]
```
